pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image for the exact Catalan concept CAP DE SETMANA. Create ONE image. Style: Flat 2D educational illustration, solid colors, simple clear outlines, no photographic texture or 3D rendering. Subject: Stable AAC temporal symbol consistent with existing CACE days: a single horizontal row of EXACTLY SEVEN separate small square calendar cells, each containing ONE simple yellow sun. First FIVE cells have neutral white fill with thin gray outlines. LAST TWO cells, positions SIX and SEVEN counting from left, both clearly highlighted with soft red fill and thick red outlines. A single plain red bracket underneath ONLY the last two cells groups them together. No arrows needed. White background, no text, letters, numerals, weekday initials or labels. Verify exactly seven cells and only last two highlighted. Composition: pure white background, isolated complete subject or compact necessary scene only, keep the entire subject within the central 75 percent of the canvas, leaving a generous uninterrupted white margin on EVERY side including above heads and below feet or wheels. All objects and people fully inside frame, natural anatomy and hands. No text, letters, numerals, names, labels, branding, logos, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including packaging, books, clothing or hardware. No frame, no collage. The vocabulary label is shown outside the image by the app.
pla-01.review: Cap de setmana: exactament set caselles amb un sol cadascuna; cinc neutres i només la sisena i setena ressaltades en vermell i agrupades. Sense text o xifres.

alt.ca: Set caselles amb un sol cadascuna; les dues últimes estan ressaltades i agrupades.
alt.es: Siete casillas con un sol cada una; las dos últimas están resaltadas y agrupadas.
